message.content:
A medium‑sized (about 182 g) raw apple typically contains **≈ 95 kcal** (or ~400 kJ).  
Calories can vary slightly:

| Size / Weight | Calories |
|---------------|----------|
| Small (149 g) | ~80–85 kcal |
| Medium (182 g)| ~90–100 kcal |
| Large (223 g) | ~110–120 kcal |

These figures assume a standard sweet variety like Fuji or Gala. Different cultivars or very small “mini” apples may fall at the lower end, while larger varieties (e.g., Honeycrisp) can approach the higher range.
